claims_note: Listed above are the substantive claims, taken from the deepest tier's key learning points. Every statement about an appearance, a sequence or an artefact in the page body requires the same verification; these are the ones a reviewer should start with.
content_rule: Decision 006: this page may carry measurements and every one of them is written from standard teaching rather than from a retrieved paper. None has been checked against a source, because the build environment has none. Each figure is registered in pipeline/config/figures/<page_id>.json with the sentence it supports and a verification state. A condition page is where that constraint bites hardest: incidence, outcome and failure rates are the content a reader comes for, every one of them is a published quantity, and none appears on these pages. ACC-001 does not reach the condition page type, so the gate would not have refused a diagnostic accuracy figure here; the omission is editorial and deliberate rather than enforced, and a reviewer should know the difference.
gaps_or_uncertainties: No measurement appears on this page. Where one would normally sit the page gives the relationship instead, because the value is not one this environment can state with confidence.

No diagnostic accuracy figure appears on this page, under decision 028. Every claim about how good a modality or a sequence is, is stated as a comparison rather than a number, and the comparison is a judgement a reviewer must agree with rather than look up.

This page's tier set, boundary list and scope sentence come from decision 027, because Part 1 maps Section 5 in one sentence and Part 2 is not in this repository. Part 1 states no tier set for Section 5 at all, which makes this weaker than Section 4's derivation, where one sentence named the tiers.
The imaging template itself is unvalidated. Decision 028 invented it and no editorial authority has confirmed its six sections.
architecture_check: Written against the architecture's own brief for 6.1.4, including its must_not_cover list: Structure level anatomy (owned by Section 2); Biomechanics beyond what the condition depends on (owned by Section 3); Examination technique and interpretation (owned by Section 4); Imaging acquisition and appearance (owned by Section 5); Operative technique (owned by Section 7); Rehabilitation protocol detail (owned by Section 8); Another condition's presentation or management (owned per chapter by 6.1 to 6.156)
